cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a jewelry appraisal room — a velvet-topped table, a lamp with a magnifier, small trays of loose stones and a safe in the corner
cuts.scene: she is the owner of the jewelry house seated with her legs crossed, studying a velvet ring box in her hand
cuts.outfit: a gem appraiser look fitted to her body — a fitted sleeveless blouse and short pencil skirt with a gem-trim belt, bare arms and legs, a diamond-shaped horn-like hairpin
